title: Paper Cup · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paper Cup · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Give the lead one sheet for folding and a small ball made from a second sheet. The lead folds the sheet into a small freestanding container without using tape. The container stands and holds one crumpled paper ball for five seconds. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Two sheets of paper.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paper Cup, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The container stands and holds one crumpled paper ball for five seconds.
recall.why: The container stands and holds one crumpled paper ball for five seconds.
